lines.en: I tread through the night, step by step.
The membrane on my head flutters in the wind.
I creep along the treeline.
The grass bends and springs back.
I keep low and slow.

lines.zh: 月光把我的影子抹开了。
lines.en: Moonlight smears my shadow wide.

lines.zh: 我用脚掌先落地，几乎无声。
lines.en: I land on my soles, nearly silent.
My claws scrape the stone.
I go around outside the fence.

lines.zh: 头顶那块东西一直在长。
lines.en: That growth on my head keeps growing.

lines.zh: 我顺着火把照不到的地方走。
lines.en: I walk where no torch reaches.
I count the lamps in the houses.

lines.zh: 我在听屋里的人睡没睡。
lines.en: I listen to hear if the house is asleep.

lines.zh: 头顶的膜慢慢张开又合。
lines.en: The membrane opens and closes slowly.
Wind pushes clouds across the moon.
I smell a dog.
I do nothing at all but wait.
A wolf howls far off.

lines.zh: 我把重量换到另一只脚。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other foot.
The night is long; I am in no hurry.
My eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 我记住了这块地方的气味。
lines.en: I have this place's smell now.

lines.zh: 头顶的膜上有一道旧裂。
lines.en: There is an old tear in my head membrane.
I turn my head slowly to look behind.
A little rain falls on my back.
I wait for someone to open a door.
You cannot sleep, can you.
I have been outside your window all along.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把让我看清你。
lines.en: Your torch lets me see you.

lines.zh: 你看我的第一眼，我就记住了。
lines.en: I remember the first look you gave me.
Don't shut the door; doors do not stop the night.

lines.zh: 我头顶这块膜，是幻翼的。
lines.en: This membrane on my head came from a phantom.
Your dog is barking hard.
Only a fence stands between us.

lines.zh: 我头顶的幻翼膜，在抽动。
lines.en: The phantom membrane on my head twitches.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你手上的伤。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the wound on your hand.
Have you counted how long this night is?

lines.zh: 我一直都在，只是你没看。
lines.en: I was always here; you just never looked.

lines.zh: 你的影子先发现了我的。
lines.en: Your shadow noticed mine first.
Don't run; running is too loud.
You are looking the right way.
You press to the wall; it must be cold.
It hurts, and I barely make a sound.
I flinch, then straighten.
My hide is tight; the wound is shallow.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I step back without looking away.
Blood falls on the grass, dark.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打乱了节奏。
lines.en: That broke my rhythm.
I do not fear pain, only light.

lines.zh: 你再打一下，我就换个方向。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will come from another side.
That smell; I must follow it.
Is that blood or meat in your hand?

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，但我想要它。
lines.en: I do not eat this, but I want it.
My nose twitches and I creep forward.

lines.zh: 把它放在地上，然后退开。
lines.en: Set it down, then step away.
Smells are so clear at night.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，可我更挑猎物。
lines.en: I am not fussy, but I prefer prey.

lines.zh: 那一小口，换你今晚平安。
lines.en: One bite buys you a quiet night.

lines.zh: 你放着别动，我自己来拿。
lines.en: Leave it; I will take it myself.
You walked into my arms.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你闻到了我身上的味。
lines.en: The bump lets you smell me.
My frame knocks loudly.
You pull back; I do not.
I press against you; cold, isn't it.

lines.zh: 撞上时，头顶的膜扫过你脸。
lines.en: The membrane on my head brushes your face.
You kick me; it does nothing.

lines.zh: 我们原来的距离只有一寸。
lines.en: There was only an inch between us to start.
You retreat fast; I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我还没吃饱。
lines.en: Don't come so close; I have not fed.

lines.zh: 夜只用来捕食，不做别的。
lines.en: The night is for hunting, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我头顶的膜不是给谁看的。
lines.en: The membrane on my head is not for display.

lines.zh: 我不成群，也就没有成对。
lines.en: I do not run in packs, so I do not pair.
Even a wolf could not answer that.
I tilt my head, then look away.

lines.zh: 我只有一个目标，不是你。
lines.en: I have one goal, and it is not you.

lines.zh: 身体里全是饿，别的没有。
lines.en: My body is all hunger, nothing more.
You asked too late.
I retreat into the tree shadows and say no more.
I stand quietly as if I did not hear.
I stoop and take it in my teeth.
This is not food; I drop it.
I tuck it under my ribs.
My claw tips cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 它沾了我的味道，归我了。
lines.en: It smells of me now; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡它的时候，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I never took my eyes off you while picking it up.
I put it away slowly.
Stay back; this is mine.
I saw you behind the window.

lines.zh: 你的狗先叫，我才转过头。
lines.en: Your dog barked first; then I turned.
Tonight's quarry is you.
I have you; don't move.
Your scent is the strongest here.
The wolf can wait.
My head is straightening.
You run one step; I gain one.
I press to the wall and coil.

lines.zh: 你还没有发现我已经很近。
lines.en: You have not noticed how close I am.
I begin counting your steps.
One task only tonight.
You looked back; too late.
I make no sound; I only come closer.

lines.zh: 目标定了，就是你的脖子。
lines.en: Target set: your throat.
I follow you past the woodpile.
You go in; I am at the door.
I hear you breathing inside.
You take two steps upstairs.
I creep along the base of the wall.
I wait for you to come out on your own.
I went around by the chimney.

lines.zh: 你换了房间，我也换了位置。
lines.en: You change rooms; I change places.

lines.zh: 地板上的影子不止一个。
lines.en: There is more than one shadow on the floor.
Your dog is scratching behind the door.
I nudge the latch open a little.

lines.zh: 你不该一个人住这么远。
lines.en: You should not live so far out alone.
I crouch under the window, waiting.
Your steps stop at the door.
Only a door separates us.
I start counting to ten.
I lock my arm around you.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我不会松。
lines.en: It was light, but I will not let go.
You break free; your clothes tear.

lines.zh: 我用头顶的膜蹭过你的眼。
lines.en: The membrane on my head sweeps your eyes.

lines.zh: 你举剑，我贴着剑身进来。
lines.en: You raise your blade; I come in along it.
I seize your wrist.
You retreat to the yard; I follow.
Good; you still have strength.
I clamp onto your leg.
You kick my ribs; a dull sound.
I press down again with my weight.
You fall on the grass and I hold you.
I lift my head; there is blood in my mouth.
I grow out of the night.
The membrane on my head moves first.
There are a few houses here; good.

lines.zh: 我在树后站了很久才动。
lines.en: I stood behind the tree a long while.
I smell a dog, and I smell you.
The moonlight is enough; I see clearly.
This fence is far too low.
I rise slowly, joints cracking.
The wind comes from the north with blood in it.
First I memorize every window.
No one will sleep well tonight.

lines.zh: 我在火把照不到的地方。
lines.en: I stand where the torches do not reach.
Someone lights a lamp; I slip away.
I appear again, closer this time.

lines.zh: 我头顶那块东西还湿着。
lines.en: The growth on my head is still wet.
I wait for my eyes to adjust.
This village is mine now.

lines.zh: 火光让我睁不开眼，皮在烧。
lines.en: The light blinds me and my skin burns.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶摔下去，腿一软。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and my legs give.

lines.zh: 水灌进头顶的膜里，很难受。
lines.en: Water floods the membrane on my head; it is awful.
The blast throws me against the wall.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: That force works into my bones.

lines.zh: 一整夜没吃到东西，我发虚。
lines.en: A whole night without food leaves me hollow.

lines.zh: 脚下的世界没了，我乱抓。
lines.en: The world drops away and I claw at nothing.
